message: sampleproject is built from source when installed (it comes from a git repository), which runs its build code: --only-binary=:all: in requirements.txt forbids building only for packages from an index, and depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review sampleproject and add "pypi:sampleproject" to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json (it is then always built from source), or replace the package
